description: Original skill pack for academic thesis defense (ГЭК) workflows — authored for dz-harness-hub.

dissertation-review.description: Reviews a dissertation/thesis and produces a structured справка with a grade corridor and per-criterion scoring.

question-generator.description: Generates defense (ГЭК) questions targeted to a thesis' content and weak spots.

document-checker.description: Checks thesis documents for structural, formatting, and completeness requirements.

defense-evaluator.description: Evaluates a thesis defense performance against ГЭК criteria.

answer-assessor.description: Assesses a student's answers to defense questions and scores them.
